patterns.note: Full-width content sections utilize alternating background colors (red, white, light grey, yellow) to visually delineate different content blocks.

Extremely large, bold, uppercase sans-serif typography is used for the main brand name as a background element and for prominent section titles, creating a strong, almost confrontational visual impact.
A high-contrast primary palette of vibrant red, stark white, and deep black dominates the design, with occasional bright yellow accents for specific product categories or highlights.
A massive, red, uppercase brand name ('MATHESON FOOD COMPANY') acts as a persistent background element, scrolling at a slower rate than the foreground content to create a parallax depth effect.
A compact, sticky navigation bar with a white background and brand logo appears at the top of the viewport after the user scrolls past the initial hero section.
Product and recipe sections are presented in a two-column grid layout, each item featuring an image, bold title, and sometimes a brief descriptor, often against a solid background color.

technique_notes: A large, full-viewport background text element is positioned with a lower z-index and scrolls at a slower, controlled rate than the main content using CSS transforms or JavaScript-driven parallax, creating a dynamic sense of depth.

A primary navigation bar is initially integrated into the hero or hidden, then becomes fixed to the top of the viewport with a distinct background color and reduced height after the user scrolls past a predefined threshold.
Content sections employ full-bleed background colors that alternate to clearly separate different thematic blocks, often using a simple two-column grid for displaying product or recipe items.

design_tokens.type_scale: Extremely oversized, bold, uppercase sans-serif headings (~10x body text height) with smaller, regular-weight sans-serif body and label text, creating a high-impact typographic hierarchy.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp corners throughout, with no visible rounding on buttons, cards, or image containers.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to dense in product grids and feature sections, with generous vertical spacing between major content blocks to maintain readability despite the bold aesthetic.

standout: The site's most distinctive feature is the aggressive use of an enormous, red, uppercase brand name ('MATHESON FOOD COMPANY') as a persistent, parallaxing background element that scrolls slowly behind all content. This, combined with the sharp, high-contrast color palette and direct typography, gives it a raw, unapologetic, and highly memorable brand presence.
